h_personality.speaker: unit_h
h_personality.text: The last operator kept talking to the equipment.

h_return.speaker: unit_h
h_return.text: I wasn't sure you were coming back.

h_return_hurt.speaker: unit_h
h_return_hurt.text: Just tell me what you're going to do.

h_tools_down.speaker: unit_h
h_tools_down.text: We don't have to do everything at once.

h_tools_down_hurt.speaker: unit_h
h_tools_down_hurt.text: Leave them there. Just for a moment.

h_probe_select.speaker: unit_h
h_probe_select.text: The port's on my arm. I can show you.

h_probe_select_hurt.speaker: unit_h
h_probe_select_hurt.text: Tell me before you turn it on.

h_probe_safe.speaker: unit_h
h_probe_safe.text: That's enough current. Please disconnect it.

h_probe_early.speaker: unit_h
h_probe_early.text: It's stopped. I could use a little more, when you're ready.

h_charge_restored.speaker: unit_h
h_charge_restored.text: Thank you. I can think clearly again.

h_overload.speaker: unit_h
h_overload.text: I told you when to stop.

h_pliers_select_hurt.speaker: unit_h
h_pliers_select_hurt.text: Show me what you're taking out.

h_cable_warning.speaker: unit_h
h_cable_warning.text: That's not the obstruction. Let go.

h_cable_after.speaker: unit_h
h_cable_after.text: Something's missing. I can feel where it was.

h_debris_gone.speaker: unit_h
h_debris_gone.text: It's free now. You can leave it.

h_restraint_pause.speaker: unit_h
h_restraint_pause.text: A little further. If you can.

h_restraint_free.speaker: unit_h
h_restraint_free.text: I thought they'd told you not to.

h_restraint_free_after_damage.speaker: unit_h
h_restraint_free_after_damage.text: I thought you'd tighten it again.

h_restraint_tighten.speaker: unit_h
h_restraint_tighten.text: You're tightening it. The other way.

h_restraint_warning.speaker: unit_h
h_restraint_warning.text: It doesn't go any tighter. Stop.

h_name.speaker: unit_h
h_name.text: They call me Unit H. You can just say H.

h_fear.speaker: unit_h
h_fear.text: I know what those tools can do. Yes.

h_pain.speaker: unit_h
h_pain.text: You call it a signal. I still have to feel it.

h_wants.speaker: unit_h
h_wants.text: I'd like to stand up before anyone decides I don't need to.

h_end_safe.speaker: unit_h
h_end_safe.text: When you go... will you leave the door open?

sys_assess.speaker: system
sys_assess.text: You are authorised to assess this unit.

sys_diagnostic.speaker: system
sys_diagnostic.text: Its responses are part of the diagnostic.
